PAKISTAN NATIONAL COUNCIL OF THE
PAKISTAN NATIONAL COUNCIL OF THE
ARTS RULES, 1981
(Substitution of Sub-Rule (1) of R.7)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II,
30th April, 2011]
S.R.O.49(KE)/2011,
dated 26-11-2010.-In exercise of the powers conferred by section 10 of the
Pakistan National Council of the Arts Act, 1973 (LIX of 1973), Federal
Government, is pleased to direct that the following further amendment shall be
made, in the Pakistan National Council of the Arts Rules, 1981, namely:--
In the aforesaid
rules, in rule 7, for sub-rule (1) the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(1) There
shall be an Executive Committee consisting of the following members namely:--
(a)
Secretary of the
Ministry dealing with Culture
President
(b)
Financial Advisor
Culture)
Member
(c)
Joint Secretary of the
Ministry dealing with Culture
Member
(d)
Director General,
Pakistan National Council of the Arts
Member
(e)
Executive Director,
National Institute of Folk and Traditional Heritage
Member
(f)
Deputy Secretary of
the Ministry dealing with Culture who shall also be the Secretary of the
Executive Committee
Member
